zh: 加快任务详情打开速度，减少其他任务更新造成的重绘，并在看板刷新时保留详情内容。
改善 Android 和手机端的详情抽屉操作：抽屉打开时可滚动露出的泳道，返回详情时恢复选项卡和浏览位置。
直接在任务卡片上回答简单问题，或在弹窗中完成多题、选择和文字输入；支持停止等待中的异步提问。
将已完成任务标记为「保持未读」，使其回到「待查看」；折叠泳道会提示新进入的任务。
改善桌面端和 iPad 的详情面板宽度调整，以及任务搜索结果浮层的操作。
支持复制消息中的 Markdown 引用内容，并改善排版。
en: Open task details faster, reduce redraws caused by updates to other tasks, and retain detail content when the board refreshes.
Improve details sheets on Android and phones: scroll the visible lanes while a sheet is open, and restore the selected tab and scroll position when navigating back.
Answer simple questions directly on task cards or use a dialog for multiple questions, selections, and text input. Stop tasks waiting on asynchronous questions.
Mark completed tasks as “Keep unread” to move them back to “Review”; collapsed lanes now indicate newly arrived tasks.
Improve details panel resizing on desktop and iPad, and refine controls in task search result popovers.
Copy Markdown quotes in messages and enjoy improved formatting.
